text: I left around half past seven on Friday and went straight home. I was at the bench most of the afternoon. I found the case empty at seven-thirty Saturday morning. As for Kessler-Ward, I have never heard of them.

assertions.claim: I left the building around 19:30 on Friday.
I have never heard of Kessler-Ward.
assertions.note: Her own notebook names Kessler-Ward and shows she opposed the sale.

text: I finished the calibration and left the building at nine o'clock sharp. I went straight home. I haven't been near Storage Room B since six on Friday. And I've never asked anyone to touch the camera system. I wouldn't know how.

assertions.claim: I left the building at 21:00 and went straight home.
I haven't been near Storage Room B since 18:00.
I never asked anyone to touch the camera system.

text: I was in my office all evening going over the quarterly budget. I didn't leave until ten at the earliest. I saw no one and heard nothing.

assertions.claim: I stayed in the building until at least 22:00.
assertions.note: He was meeting Kessler-Ward's counsel and hid it to protect the deal.

text: I never left the lobby desk during my shift. Not once. I logged nothing unusual. If anyone had come through, I would have seen them.

assertions.claim: I never left the lobby desk during my shift.
assertions.note: A hospital call about her son took her from the desk.

text: I was at home all evening. I didn't touch the camera system on Friday night. Everything was running normally as far as I know.

assertions.claim: I didn't touch the camera system on Friday night.
assertions.note: He carried out a work order that Alex Reyes submitted.
